howItWorks.title: From first message to first breakthrough.
howItWorks.intro: Getting started takes minutes — and the first conversation is always free.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Send one message with the subject, level, and where the student is struggling. It takes two minutes.
howItWorks.step2Desc: We assess the gaps and match the student with the right subject specialist — no charge, no pressure.
howItWorks.step3Desc: One-to-one, using the plan from your consultation — exam technique and real past papers, until the grade moves.

statement.text: We don't run classes. We build a plan around one student.

programs.galleryIntro: GCSE, A-Level, IB, Tawjihi, standardised tests, and everyday schoolwork — taught by specialists who know each syllabus inside out. Don't see it here? Ask us anyway.
programs.pageIntro: We cover the most widely studied curricula and exams in Palestine, plus the standardised tests students need for university abroad — and everyday coursework in between. If your subject isn't listed, get in touch and we'll find the right tutor.
programs.gradeRange: From Grade 1 through university admission — every subject, every level.

gcse.name: GCSE
gcse.shortDesc: Core and extended subjects for Years 10–11 students
gcse.longDesc: Our GCSE programme supports Years 10 and 11 students sitting Cambridge IGCSE and Edexcel GCSE examinations. We cover all core and extended subjects with a focus on exam technique and conceptual clarity.

alevel.name: A-Level
alevel.longDesc: For students in Years 12 and 13 preparing for A-Level examinations. Our tutors specialise in the subjects most commonly required for university admissions, with structured revision plans and past paper practice.

ib.name: IB
ib.shortDesc: Higher and Standard Level across all IB groups
ib.longDesc: We support IB Diploma students across Higher and Standard Level subjects. Sessions cover the full IB syllabus including Internal Assessments, Extended Essays, and exam preparation.

tawjihi.name: Tawjihi
tawjihi.shortDesc: Full support for the Palestinian national curriculum
tawjihi.longDesc: Complete preparation for the Palestinian General Secondary Education Certificate (Tawjihi). We cover all branches — Scientific, Literary, and Commercial — with tutors who understand the Ministry of Education curriculum.

sat.name: SAT
sat.shortDesc: Preparation for the US college admissions test
sat.longDesc: Structured preparation for the SAT, covering Reading, Writing, and Math, with timed practice tests and focused work on each student's weaker sections.

ielts.name: IELTS
ielts.shortDesc: Preparation for the international English language test
ielts.longDesc: Focused preparation across all four IELTS components — Listening, Reading, Writing, and Speaking — for students applying to universities or programmes that require an English proficiency score.

toefl.name: TOEFL
toefl.shortDesc: Preparation for the Test of English as a Foreign Language
toefl.longDesc: Focused preparation for the TOEFL iBT, covering Reading, Listening, Speaking, and Writing, for students applying to universities that require this specific English proficiency score.

ap.name: AP
ap.longDesc: Exam-focused tutoring for Advanced Placement subjects, built around the official AP curriculum and scoring criteria, with practice drawn from past exam questions.

clep.name: CLEP
clep.shortDesc: Preparation for College-Level Examination Program tests
clep.longDesc: Targeted preparation for CLEP exams, helping students test out of introductory college courses and earn credit faster.

gre.name: GRE
gre.longDesc: Preparation for the GRE General Test — Verbal Reasoning, Quantitative Reasoning, and Analytical Writing — for students applying to graduate programmes abroad.

checkpoint.name: Checkpoint
checkpoint.shortDesc: Cambridge Checkpoint and progression tests for younger students
checkpoint.longDesc: Support for Cambridge Primary and Lower Secondary Checkpoint exams, helping younger students build strong foundations before they begin GCSE or IGCSE.

schoolCurriculum.name: School Curriculum
schoolCurriculum.shortDesc: Homework and coursework support across any school curriculum
schoolCurriculum.longDesc: Not preparing for a specific exam yet? We support day-to-day schoolwork and homework across any curriculum, keeping students on track between formal exam preparation.

about.story1: Ilm Learning Center was founded in Palestine with one goal: to give every student access to the kind of expert, focused tutoring that makes the difference between struggling and succeeding. Ilm (علم) means knowledge in Arabic — it's not just our name, it's our purpose.
about.story2: We work with students preparing for GCSE, A-Level, IB, Tawjihi, SAT, IELTS, AP, CLEP, and everyday schoolwork — matched one-to-one with a tutor who specialises in that exact subject and syllabus, not a generalist covering everything.
about.videoIntro: A short look at what we teach and how a session actually works.

excellence.title: Excellence
excellence.desc: We hold our tutors to high standards and our students to even higher ones. Good enough is never the goal.

personalisation.title: Personalisation
personalisation.desc: Every plan starts with a real diagnostic — where the student is actually stuck — not a syllabus we run through top to bottom regardless.

community.title: Community
community.desc: We're Palestinian educators serving Palestinian students. This isn't just a service, it's a commitment.

about.familyTitle: This is what the Ilm family looks like.
about.familyBody: Behind every grade is a room full of people who know each student by name. This is the community our students walk into — and the one you're welcome to join.
about.familyNote: Every student here started with a single message. There's always room for one more.
